description.value:
Range 60 feet, centered on you

Duration continuous

A constant, low-grade sense for nearby Anchored spirits and hostile ghost-machines within range — not their location precisely, just a building pressure, like a held breath. This is always on; it can't be dismissed or suppressed, and keeps working even while you're unconscious, asleep, or otherwise incapacitated.

cinderfall.incomplete: pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/sense.ts:23 confirms Sense's selector field is a closed StringField enum (SENSE_TYPES); no real sense type means 'detect Anchor-bound spirits/ghost-machines specifically'. Unlike Static Flood, this ability does have a fixed numeric range (60 ft) and a real acuity precedent for 'imprecise' senses, so the shape ({"key":"Sense","selector":"<X>","acuity":"imprecise","range":60}) is otherwise buildable -- the sole blocker is that no real sense type in the closed enum means 'detect Anchored spirits/ghost-machines specifically.' lifesense is the closest real value but would also detect ordinary living creatures the card explicitly excludes; per this project's standing 'convert, never flatten' rule, a mismatched real sense is not substituted for a missing homebrew category.
cinderfall.notSpell: wardbreaker's class document carries system.spellcasting 0, so this is an ability, not a spell; it also matches no rank heading in spells-abilities.html, which is why the spell converter left it alone
